title: The Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of an abelian sheaf on a site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The theorem produces the spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(F)) converging to H^{p+q}(U, F) for an arbitrary covering U = {U_i to U} of an object of a site and an arbitrary abelian sheaf F, with H^q(F) the presheaf V mapping to H^q(V, F). The proof at etale-cohomology.tex lines 1788-1803 must first place the global-sections complex and the Cech complex of an injective resolution into one double complex, and then argue row exactness in positive degrees by combining two separate facts: injectives of abelian sheaves remain injective as presheaves (Tag 03OV, via the exact left adjoint sheafification) and Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf vanishes above degree zero (Tag 03OR). The step that pins the abutment is the identification at lines 1809-1815 of the kernel of the first Cech differential with Gamma(U, I^bullet), which uses that the resolution consists of sheaves rather than merely presheaves; the E_2-page is then read off columnwise at lines 1817-1829.
